scenes.line1: Ever lost work or found a bug?
scenes.say: Have you ever needed to save unfinished changes or track down a bug? Git has tools for that.

scenes.label: Cherry-pick
scenes.sub: Apply a specific commit to your branch.
scenes.say: Cherry-pick lets you grab a single commit from another branch and add it to yours.

scenes.title: Stash Workflow
scenes.say: Stash temporarily saves your changes when you need to switch tasks. Later, you can restore them and keep working.
Bisect helps you find which commit introduced a bug. You mark good and bad versions, and Git narrows it down.

scenes.question: How do you debug a regression?
scenes.right: Use bisect to quickly pinpoint the bad commit.
scenes.say: In an interview, don’t say you check every commit. Mention using bisect to search efficiently.
